The wood has a light-to-medium brown finish. To the left, there is a potted plant with white flowers. In the background, a dark radiator and a window with vertical bars are visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The spines of the books lack distinct text, logos, or realistic details. They appear as smeared, repetitive patterns rather than individual book spines. This is a common AI artifact where fine text/details fail to render correctly.
The horizontal lines defining the drawers in the lower section waver and merge slightly. The handles/knobs are indistinct blobs rather than sharp geometric shapes, suggesting structural ambiguity.

The top edge of the bookcase seems to curve slightly unnaturally, and the perspective lines of the side panel do not perfectly align with the expected vanishing point, giving a slight 'melting' feel to the rigid wood structure.
The plant leaves and flowers exhibit a painterly blur that doesn't match typical depth-of-field bokeh; edges bleed into the background in a way characteristic of generative smoothing.
